purpose: Exploratory data understanding, not model training
snapshot_scope: train snapshots days 180–537 inclusive; label days through 544
target_decision: User confirmed any recorded BASKET_ID in (snapshot, snapshot+7], including zero-sales, fuel and miscellaneous baskets.
quantity_decision: Exclude QUANTITY from cross-department behavior aggregation while units remain unverified; retain it in raw-data quality analysis.

definitions.any_basket: at least one recorded BASKET_ID in (snapshot, snapshot+7]
definitions.positive_basket: at least one basket whose sum of SALES_VALUE > 0 in the horizon
definitions.grocery_department: at least one basket containing department GROCERY; excludes other food departments

cautions: Outcomes describe purchases recorded by this retailer, not shopping elsewhere.
Household-snapshot observations repeat; counts and rates are not independent people.
Demographics are described retrospectively; availability at cutoff is unverified.
Coupon discount is a transaction signal, not proof of causal effect or exposure.
High quantity values are observed; units or scaling for fuel remain unverified.
SALES_VALUE is retailer receipts and may differ from customer out-of-pocket payment.
Days 278 and 643 have one basket each; source or calendar cause is unverified.
